w: After his morning puja, Swamishri sanctified and performed the Bhumi pujan of the soil from the new mandir site in Portland.

During the evening public assembly, Congressman Pete Stark presented a 'Certificate of Special Congressional Recognition' to Swamishri. The Supervisor of Santa Clara County, Mr. Pete McHugh, welcomed and honored Swamishri with a 'Key to the City'.
ph: Santa Clara Councillor Pete McHugh honoring Pramukh Swami Maharaj with the key to the County of Santa Clara on September 17, 2000

w: Swamishri celebrated Jal Jhilani festival by virtually batting Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Shri Ganeshji. ( See special report )
Through festivals Shriji Maharaj has shown us the path of unbroken communion with God and consolidation of His commands in our lives.
Discourses on God relieve one's fatigue.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
31 Aug 2002, Atladra
35 children from Vaghodiya pilgrimaged by foot to the mandir.
2 Sept 2002, Atladra
Swamishri blessed 20 children who had pilgrimaged 26 km.
4 Sept 2002, Atladra
Over 65 devotees from the village of Zaradka, Alali, Padra and Chansad had pilgrimaged all night in the rain to reach the mandir in the morning.
4 Sept 2002, Nadiad
Swamishri blessed 20 balaks and 5 kishores for having pilgrimaged 12 km.

After his morning routine of darshan, puja and breakfast, Swamishri had a series of meetings to attend. Since the meetings could last till noon, Swamishri asked whether it would do if he did not attend the morning assembly. A sadhu organizing the assembly program sent a message that it would be alright if he could not come.

Swamishri could have sent word that he would not come, but instead, he took permission from the organizer. Swamishri's humility and discipline in his working method is inspiring and worthy of emulation.

Murti-Pratishtha Mahotsav Despite ill health, Swamishri had come specially for the inauguration of this new BAPS mandir. Swamishri performed the traditional Vedic murti-pratishtha ceremony of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Shri Radha-Krishna Dev and the Guru Parampara. Then blessing the assembly Swamishri said, “The aim of human life is liberation. That is why, to guide man, Bhagwan Purushottam Narayan incarnated on this earth with His abode (ideal devotee – Gunatitanand Swami). With the blessings of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj, Satsang has grown in India and abroad. “Gardens give fragrance to all, water quenches thirst, trees give shade, similarly, God and His Sadhu work to benefit others. By their darshan, done knowingly or unknowingly, one attains peace – just as one becomes immortal if one drinks nectar even unknowingly.”
In the evening assembly, the Indian High Commissioner, Lal Mavana, was present.

In the evening assembly youths and children presented a cultural programme themed ‘Colouring Mumbai’. A drama on a parable by Yogiji Maharaj ‘Titodi’s Eggs’ was enacted. It reflected the message of samp, suhrudbhav and ekta. Thereafter a cultural dance was performed by children. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly, “How many people would be required to colour the whole of Mumbai (with values)? If you persevere with faith and patience then it can be done. Nothing is impossible. Pebble by pebble you can build a wall. If you endeavour little by little with faith, then a great work can be accomplished. When you study regularly you gradually attain a degree. You can become a doctor, scientist or an engineer…”

At 11.47 am Swamishri and his entourage of sadhus and devotees departed by flight from Chino Hills (LA) and landed at La Guardia airport at 7.45 pm (4.45 pm LA time). At 8.00 pm Swamishri arrived at the BAPS Swaminarayan hari mandir in Flushing, New York.

Kirtan Patel, a satsangi kishore, asked Swamishri, “Next year I’ll be going to college. What should I be careful about?” Swamishri replied, “Study properly in college, and be firm about satsang. Take care of your niyams. Be careful you do not fall into bad company and do not become friends with mischievous boys. Also be careful that you do not lapse in remaining vegetarian. In short, stay with good boys, remain vegetarian, pay attention to your studies and watch only good programmes on TV.” Then Kirtan requested “Give me one niyam.” Swamishri replied, “Inspire one boy to become a satsangi every year. This will also strengthen your own faith. To achieve this read our satsang books regularly.” Kirtan further asked, “Maharaj has spoken about the glory of the Satpurush in many Vachanamruts. How can one understand his true glory?” Swamishri answered, “Through love for the Satpurush the soul becomes attached to him. Then whatever he says or instructs one believes it to be right. Through love one comes closer to him, trusts him and becomes deeply attached to him.”
